Class HiringDecisions

java.lang.Object
edu.ucsb.cs.taapply.services.HiringDecisions
public final class HiringDecisions extends Object
The rules about releasing hiring decisions, i.e. publishing a recruitment's assignments (issue #237; design in docs/design/AdminUserInterfaceDesign.md, "Hiring decisions and reopening"). One place, so the endpoint that refuses a release, the steps endpoint and the published assignments page all agree.
